Its head is lowered slightly, looking towards the camera. The distinctive ridge along the spine is not clearly visible from this angle.

The vertical lines of the cabinet drawer and side panel show slight warping/bending, suggesting minor geometric instability in the background structure.
The black chair legs in the background appear to merge into the wall/floor inconsistently. The geometry of the chair seat and legs is ambiguous and physically questionable.
